lesson_title: Regulation, Digital Disruption and the BBFC, OFCOM, IPSO, ASA and PEGI

items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to UK media regulators and the challenges of regulating digital platforms.

items.title: Media Studies — Ofcom and UK Broadcast TV Regulation — Mrs Fisher
items.description: GCSE-level guide to Ofcom's role in regulating UK broadcast media — essential for this lesson.

items.title: What is Ofcom? — Ofcom Official
items.description: Official Ofcom explainer — straight from the regulator's own channel.

items.title: The Great Hack (2019)
items.description: The Cambridge Analytica scandal — a vivid case study in what happens when digital platforms go unregulated.

items.title: Don't Look Up (2021)
items.description: A satirical take on media failure, public interest and regulatory inaction — great for discussing why regulation matters.

items.title: BBFC — About Classification
items.description: Official BBFC explanation of how film and video content is classified in the UK — primary source for exam revision.

items.title: IPSO — Independent Press Standards Organisation
items.description: The UK's independent press regulator. Read real complaint rulings and understand how print and digital news is regulated.

items.title: ASA — Advertising Standards Authority
items.description: The UK advertising regulator. Browse rulings to see how ASA enforces advertising standards across media.

items.title: PEGI — Pan European Game Information
items.description: The official PEGI age rating system for video games — essential for understanding game regulation in the digital age.
